name: field-goal-angel-foam-rolling
instructions:
1. In a supine position, place a foam roller directly underneath the length of your spine.
2. Position your arms parallel to your torso at right angles and focus on stretching the pecs.
3. While keeping your hands in line with your torso, exhale while extending your arms and reach overhead.
4. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
